title: Hiking in the Rockies - Group hike tour near Denver
includes: If you ask ahead of time, we can bring an extra layer, hat or gloves for you!
We have spikes available in the winter for people who need additional traction on their shoes.
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Do you want to go for a hike but don't know which trail to pick, and don't want to get lost in the forest? We make things easy for you by taking you to a beautiful trail and making sure you have a stress-free time, enjoying the natural beauty of the Rocky Mountains.
